posts.en:
fs-mcp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Paddock: constrained local filesystem MCP server for agents — text read/write, directory ops, filename and content search confined to configurable zones, with zero runtime dependencies and a dsh bundle.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9bc18f0cb11794a366f1.html
